subject: Cross-team timing coordination for latency benchmark readout
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Cho <evan.cho@finova.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cross-team timing coordination for latency benchmark readout

Hi Evan —

Thanks again for running the PoC with our small-batch profiles. Your team’s traces were really helpful. We’d like to schedule a 45–60 minute readout to walk through the latency benchmark results, discuss observed tail behavior, and outline remediation / configuration recommendations.

Who from your side should join? From Redwood we typically bring: AE (me) + SE (Marcus) + Solutions/ops (Rishi) for procurement/security questions.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue May 25: 9:30–10:30 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed May 26: 11:00–12:00 or 16:00–17:00

I attached a short readout agenda and the PDF summary of the latency runs (redwood_latency_summary_v2.pdf). If those slots don’t work, please share a few slots next week. Also flag any procurement or security folks who must join so we can include Monica.

Quick goals:
- Share top-line latency percentiles and regression surface
- Identify immediate tuning (batching/KV cache) options
- Agree next steps: runbook, success criteria, and contracting timeline

Thanks —
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: redwood_readout_agenda.docx (agenda, 1 page)
Attachment: redwood_latency_summary_v2.pdf (summary slides, 6 pages)

From: Evan Cho <evan.cho@finova.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@finova.com>, procurement@finova.com
Date: 2027-05-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-team timing coordination for latency benchmark readout

Jasmine —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the summary. Appreciate the clarity. Our engineers are available but a couple of constraints:
- Security lead (Olivia) can only join between 13:30–16:00 PST on Tue/Wed.
- Procurement needs 72 hours notice before being pulled into contract discussions; might only attend the final wrap if there are PO/price items.

Suggested compromise: Tue May 25 at 14:00–15:00 PST is best for our security and core infra folks. If you prefer a 60-minute slot, we can keep 14:00–15:00 and skip the deep config dive — follow up with a separate runbook session.

I’ll loop the engineering distro (dev-eng@finova.com) once we lock time.

—Evan
Evan Cho | Senior Engineering Manager, Finova Systems
ev an.cho@finova.com | +1 (206) 555-0890

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-05-19T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-team timing coordination for latency benchmark readout

Forwarding schedule availability + runbook ask.

Jasmine — I can make Tue 5/25 14:00–15:00 PST. Proposal: 40-minute readout (top-line + security/Q&A) and then a 30-minute technical deep dive the following week with your infra team and our latency engineer. That keeps security/procurement bandwidth focused and gives us time to prepare a short remediation playbook.

Action items I’ll own if we confirm Tue 14:00:
- 1 pager of top five latency observations (to be shared before the call)
- Short screen + replay of KV cache behavior (10 minutes)
- Post-call ticket with prioritized config changes + estimated CPU/GPU cost impact

If procurement wants a contract step earlier, Monica can coordinate.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin | Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (617) 555-0321

- 14:50 – 15:00: Next steps / procurement touchpoints (Monica)
